unproject_masked_depth_to_xyz: unproject a batch of posed RGBD depth images to 3D XYZ coordinates using PyTorch tensors
unproject_coordinates: unproject image coordinates with metric depth to 3D world space coordinates using numpy and magnum matrices
project_to_im_coordinates: project a batch of 3D world coordinates to 2D image pixel coordinates using camera and projection matrices
opengl_to_opencv: convert an OpenGL camera pose matrix to OpenCV format by flipping the Y and Z axes
review_geometric_utils: review the geometric utility functions for camera coordinate transformations between image space and 3D world space
